# A longer browser-test timeout does not configure the OAuth server timeout

Entry 1515 calls requestLongerTimeout(2) and explains that the CalDAV OAuth test file relies on shared server/login state. That extends the browser test harness timeout; the diff does not change an OAuth server-specific timeout setting. Retain the reported intent as historical context and keep the stateful sequence together when judging a split. The actual intermittent root cause, wall-clock duration and review rationale remain unread. Static source and test-code inspection only. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime or live accessibility result is claimed.

Scope: CalDAV OAuth test timing.
